title: The unopened letter, ii
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: Tuesday. The pup sniffs the envelope. The logo, drawn as a blank shape, is the only thing in the strip that isn't drawn. The letter moves four inches across four panels; nobody touches it.

panels.composition: The drafting table. The envelope, its logo a blank shape. BARNABY II's nose approaching from the left edge.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a drafting table with an envelope bearing a blank shape where a logo would be, a small dog's nose entering from the left edge

panels.composition: The nose at the envelope. A sniff. The envelope nudged an inch.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a small three-legged dog sniffing an envelope on a table and nudging it slightly

panels.composition: WOOD's hand entering from the right, reaching — then stopping, and picking up the mug beside it instead. The envelope nudged again by the mug.

characters.pose: hand, picking up the mug instead

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a man's hand reaching toward an envelope on a table and taking the coffee mug beside it instead, nudging the envelope

panels.composition: The envelope four inches from where it began, unopened. The dog gone. The hand gone. The blank shape.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, an envelope with a blank logo shape lying unopened on a drafting table four inches from a faint dust outline where it was, no words

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; Sundays wet-on-wet; 2019: the Sunday drawn to a smaller grid
art.palette: ink and one tone; Sundays gray-green, fog, rust; 2020: ochre and slate arriving

notes: Four inches in four panels. Never touched on purpose.
